org.rationale: It describes the name of organization and does not have any security impact.

addons_config.description: Addon configurations of the Apigee organization.
addons_config.rationale: Certain addons_config arguments provide security impact

advanced_api_ops_config.description: Configuration for the Advanced API Ops add-on.
advanced_api_ops_config.rationale: advanced_api_ops_config detect, analyze, and alert on API traffic anomalies in real-time, such as unexpected latency spikes or error rate changes

integration_config.rationale: It allows Apigee to integrate with other Google Cloud services and third-party applications and does not have any security impact

monetization_config.rationale: It is used to enable or disable the Apigee Monetization add-on for a specific Apigee organization and does not have security impact.

api_security_config.description: Configuration for the API Security add-on.
api_security_config.rationale: It should be enabled to detect API security risks, flag abnormal traffic

connectors_platform_config.rationale: It enable or disable the Integration Connectors platform within an Apigee organization
